column7: Frequency setpoint in 0.1 Hz (500 = 50.0 Hz); needs P1-12 = 4.
Accel/decel time 0-60000 = 0.00-600.00 s; used only when P5-07 = 1.
Low byte = status bits, high byte = fault code when tripped.
column15: bit 0 = 1 = running (enabled), 0 = stopped; bit 1 = 1 = tripped, 0 = healthy; bit 2 = 1 = Hand, 0 = Auto; bit 3 = Inhibit; bit 4 = Service due; bit 5 = Standby (sleep) active; bit 6 = Drive ready; bit 7 = 1 = low or high load condition detected; bit 8 = Bits 8-15 (upper byte): fault code number while tripped (50 = Modbus timeout)
bit 0 = Digital input 1; bit 1 = Digital input 2; bit 2 = Digital input 3
